problem_type: Declaration capability and executable wire diverge at publication
symptom: Declared media models lose parameters and required references, advertise chat and retain removed routes.
direct_cause: Registration drops capability fields; promotion separately builds metadata and mappings; old rows have no recovery.
class_root: No complete atomic projection owns the declared capability, wire and replacement lifecycle.
affected_population: New and legacy declared media models across connections and both publication paths
entry_points: workflow import -> capabilityDraftForImportedWorkflow -> lifecycleArtifacts -> promoteCertifiedComfyCandidate -> defaultCatalog.promote
internal_only_reason: This is an internal projection invariant; wire protocols are passed through unchanged and external protocol implementation belongs to a separate change.
invariants: Registration and promotion compile the same capability and wire fact.
Only declared modes publish; required reference slots remain required.
Unsupported or conflicting shapes reject atomically before persistence.
Legacy recovery uses only matching original revisions or a vendor-bound, digest-checked durable declaration snapshot and never calls a provider.
Declared UI defaults feed mapping defaultParams; canonical request.params bindings prevent controls and headless requests diverging.
Original per-model declaration source and static untried evidence persist in the catalog transaction.
Declaration parameter names come from the code-owned canonical registry and share the existing parameter-to-wire coverage invariant.

door_reduction.why_not: Declaration, leased certification and one-time migration remain separate lifecycle entries and call the same compiler. Specification and canvas/storyboard readers consume its persisted contract. Availability and publication independently answer eligibility using the same diagnosis. Workflow import, materialization, connector, integration session, adapter coordinator and parity probe retain their lifecycle roles. The complete promotion property census and one-hop wrappers are generated by door-map; the added door is an internal call from the existing lifecycle to the extracted workflow capability constructor, not a new external writer.

generality_proof: The compiler operates on declared kind/task/reference/parameter structure, independent of identity or provider; both writes and legacy recovery converge on it.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Compile complete capabilities and exact wire with field errors.
Recover matching original revision or durable declaration snapshot facts, otherwise mark missing capability.
Reject incomplete or withdrawn declared modes only at creation; leave accepted-task queries on their original read path.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Uses the same compiler and replacement ownership.
Materialization and integration session terminal callbacks supply complete workflow facts to the same promotion compiler; the inventory matrix covers each input lifecycle.
Preserves controls and explicit reference shape/parameter; deleting referenceParam makes the caller matrix fail.

recurrence.reason: Every new model, declaration replacement and prior installed catalog can reach this missing invariant.
same_class_scan: door-map of registerDeclaredProvider, mappingRowFromDeclaredMode, adapterModelMetadataForPromotion, agentModelEntriesFromCatalog, buildAgentModelEntries
Inspected both catalog writers, renderer archetype consumer, modelPublication and original revision store.
Generated promote property census plus promoteCertifiedComfyCandidate wrapper hops; inventory-driven 6 caller by 5 lifecycle matrix.

prevention.invariant: Capability and mappings compile together and replace only owned facts.
prevention.failure_mode: Field-specific exception before writes; unavailable legacy rows are preserved and blocked.
prevention.strategy: Both publication writers compile one complete fact and reject unowned replacement. Creation passes the shared guard before spend/HTTP; read-only resolution for accepted task queries remains unchanged. Native import controls and all media references enter this compiler intact; it derives existing array slots and indexed node bindings. Declaration source snapshots and untried evidence commit atomically; new card controls use the code-owned canonical registry and existing param-map coverage invariant.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove inline mapping construction and media chat fallback in the same change.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The defect is internal metadata ownership; no new runtime dependency or protocol is needed.

migration: Version 14 reprojects only matching original revision or a vendor-bound, digest-checked durable declaration snapshot with compatible original wire; compiled defaults and canonical parameter bindings feed the same runtime. Both ordinary load and boot seed entry supply originals. Missing, conflicting or unsupported originals get a durable missing-capability marker; Agent lists it and dispatch rejects before execution. Complete user-authored contracts remain unchanged.
residual_risks: Live upstream generation, Windows and paid verification are outside this local loopback validation.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The pure projection owns capability and wire completeness; matrix and migration tests exercise real catalog writes and original revision recovery.
